# netskopebwan_app_categories (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every page is walked, so data holds the whole collection and total_count is
# what the API reports for it. A filter narrows the list; sort orders it.
data "netskopebwan_app_categories" "example" {
  filter = "name eq \"example\""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String)
- `sort` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total_count` (Number) Number of objects the API reports for this collection.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Qosmos category id e.g. 24. This is the same as the qosmosAppId in string form
- `name` (String) Qosmos category name e.g. "Standard"
- `qosmos_id` (Number) Qosmos category id e.g. 24
